description: Trigger evals: queries that should and should not activate cut-verifier.
positive: Does this cut list actually close on 36 inches?
Verify the dimensions on my bench design before I cut anything.
Will these shelf parts fit between the sides?
Check the width stack-up for the cubby bench.
How many sheets of plywood do I really need for six benches?
Did I allocate my on-hand 2x4 offcuts before adding new ones to the list?
My cubby openings came out uneven — which number is wrong?
negative: Design me a mudroom bench from scratch.
Draw the print-ready build guide for this project.
Update the shop inventory now that the build is done.
What finish should I use on plywood edges?
Add a new lesson to the lessons-learned file.
notes: Positives are all requests to CHECK numbers/fit/yield. Negatives belong to build-planner (design), guide-renderer (guides), or shop-close-out (knowledge updates).
